# Business Requirements Document — Rider App (trip booking and live tracking)

Project: **Rider App** (code RID) · Team: Mobile · Department: Engineering
Scope of this BRD: the **book-a-trip and track-the-driver** flow. Rider
sign-up, payment methods and ratings exist already and are out of scope.

## Overview
Indnord runs a small employee shuttle fleet between the two office campuses
and the metro station. Riders currently phone a dispatcher. The Rider App
lets an employee request a seat on the next shuttle, see where it is, and
get notified when it is two minutes away.

## Goals
- Booking a seat takes three taps.
- A rider always knows whether they have a seat and when to be at the stop.
- No shuttle leaves with more riders than seats.

## Users
- **Rider**: books and cancels seats, tracks the assigned shuttle.
- **Driver** (driver app, separate): accepts the manifest, starts and ends
  the trip; shares location automatically.
- **Dispatcher**: views all trips and can cancel a shuttle run.

## Functional requirements

1. **Stops and routes**
   - The app shows the fixed routes (campus A to metro, campus B to metro and
     the reverse) with their stops and the scheduled departures for today.
   - Each departure has a shuttle with a fixed seat count.

2. **Booking**
   - A rider picks a route, a departure and a boarding stop and books one
     seat. A booking is **Confirmed** when a seat is free; otherwise the
     rider joins the **Waitlist** in order.
   - A rider may hold at most two future bookings and never two on the same
     departure.
   - A rider can cancel until five minutes before the scheduled departure.
     Cancelling a confirmed seat promotes the first waitlisted rider and
     notifies them.
   - Bookings close at departure time; the manifest is then frozen.

3. **Live tracking**
   - From 15 minutes before departure the rider sees the shuttle position on
     a map, refreshed at least every 10 seconds, and an estimated arrival at
     their boarding stop.
   - The rider receives a push notification when the shuttle is two minutes
     from their stop.
   - If the driver has not started the trip five minutes after the scheduled
     departure, the rider sees a "delayed" banner.

4. **Boarding**
   - The driver's manifest lists confirmed riders per stop; tapping a rider
     marks them boarded.
   - A confirmed rider not boarded by the time the shuttle leaves their stop
     is marked **No-show**. Three no-shows in 30 days moves the rider to
     waitlist-only for the next 7 days.

5. **Dispatcher**
   - The dispatcher can cancel a departure; every confirmed and waitlisted
     rider is notified and their booking is cancelled.

## Non-functional requirements
- Works on Android 10+ and iOS 15+; offline shows the last known booking
  state with a stale marker.
- Location updates from the driver app are stored for 24 hours only.
- Booking under concurrent taps never over-allocates seats.

## Out of scope
- Route planning and new routes.
- Fare or payment (the shuttle is free).
- Driver onboarding.

## Acceptance criteria
- On a 12-seat departure, the 13th booking lands on the waitlist; a
  cancellation promotes it and sends a notification.
- A rider with two future bookings gets a clear error on a third.
- The two-minute notification fires exactly once per rider per trip.
- Three no-shows in a month restrict the rider to waitlist for a week.

epics.title: Routes and Departures
epics.description: Show fixed routes, stops and today's scheduled departures with seat counts.

user_stories.title: Browse routes and departures
user_stories.narrative: As a rider, I want to see routes, stops and today's departures, so that I can choose a shuttle to book

specs.title: Route and departure data
specs.description: Read-only API and data model for fixed routes, stops, departures and per-departure seat capacity.

tasks.title: Route and departure model
tasks.description: Define routes (campus A/metro, campus B/metro, both directions), ordered stops, departures with shuttle and fixed seat count. Routes, stops and schedules are loaded from seeded fixed data (no admin UI or import); route planning is out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.when: A departure is loaded
acceptance_criteria.then: It has a shuttle, route, scheduled time and fixed seat count

acceptance_criteria.given: The system is started against an empty database
acceptance_criteria.when: The seed data is applied
acceptance_criteria.then: The campus A/metro and campus B/metro routes in both directions, their ordered stops and scheduled departures exist, and re-applying the seed does not create duplicates

tasks.confidence_note: Decision: routes, stops and schedules are loaded from idempotent seeded fixed data; no admin UI or import (route planning out of scope). Recorded in design.md.

tasks.title: Today's departures API
tasks.description: Endpoint returning routes, stops and today's scheduled departures.

acceptance_criteria.when: The client requests departures
acceptance_criteria.then: Only today's departures with their stops are returned

specs.title: Routes screen
specs.description: Mobile UI listing routes, stops and departures.

tasks.title: Routes and departures UI
tasks.description: Screen showing routes, stops and today's departures.

acceptance_criteria.when: Rider opens the app
acceptance_criteria.then: All four route directions with stops and today's departures are shown

epics.title: Booking and Waitlist
epics.description: Book, cancel and waitlist seats with limits, promotion and concurrency safety.

user_stories.title: Book a seat
user_stories.narrative: As a rider, I want to book a seat on a departure at my boarding stop, so that I know I have a seat

specs.title: Booking and waitlist allocation
specs.description: Atomic seat allocation: Confirmed if a seat is free, otherwise ordered Waitlist; enforce booking limits.

tasks.title: Atomic seat allocation
tasks.description: Create booking as Confirmed or Waitlisted in order, using transactional/locked allocation so concurrent requests never over-allocate.

acceptance_criteria.when: A 13th rider books a full 12-seat departure
acceptance_criteria.then: The booking is Waitlisted in order

acceptance_criteria.when: Many riders book the last seat concurrently
acceptance_criteria.then: Exactly one is Confirmed and others are Waitlisted

tasks.confidence_note: BRD states the outcome only; locking mechanism (row lock, serializable txn, queue) is an assumption.

tasks.title: Booking limits validation
tasks.description: Reject a booking if rider has two future bookings or already has one on the same departure; reject after departure time.

acceptance_criteria.when: A rider with two future bookings books a third
acceptance_criteria.then: A clear error is returned and no booking is created

acceptance_criteria.when: A rider books a departure they already hold
acceptance_criteria.then: The booking is rejected with an error

acceptance_criteria.when: A booking is attempted at or after departure time
acceptance_criteria.then: It is rejected

tasks.confidence_note: Assumed waitlisted bookings count toward the two-booking limit and that cancelled ones do not.

tasks.title: Booking flow UI
tasks.description: Three-tap flow: route, departure, boarding stop, showing Confirmed or Waitlist status.

acceptance_criteria.when: Rider books from the departures list
acceptance_criteria.then: Booking completes in three taps and status is displayed

tasks.confidence_note: 'Three taps' interpreted as select departure, select stop, confirm.

user_stories.title: Cancel and promotion
user_stories.narrative: As a rider, I want to cancel my booking, so that my seat can go to someone else

specs.title: Cancellation and waitlist promotion
specs.description: Cancellation allowed until 5 minutes before departure; confirmed cancellation promotes first waitlisted rider.

tasks.title: Cancel booking
tasks.description: Cancel endpoint enforcing the 5-minute cutoff.

acceptance_criteria.when: Rider cancels more than 5 minutes before departure
acceptance_criteria.then: Booking is cancelled

acceptance_criteria.when: Rider cancels within 5 minutes of departure
acceptance_criteria.then: Cancellation is rejected

tasks.title: Promote waitlisted rider
tasks.description: On confirmed cancellation promote first waitlisted rider to Confirmed and send a notification.

acceptance_criteria.when: A confirmed seat on a full departure is cancelled
acceptance_criteria.then: First waitlisted rider becomes Confirmed and receives a notification

user_stories.title: Manifest freeze
user_stories.narrative: As a driver, I want a frozen manifest at departure, so that no shuttle leaves over capacity

specs.title: Booking close at departure
specs.description: Freeze manifest at scheduled departure time.

tasks.title: Freeze manifest
tasks.description: At departure time block booking, cancellation and promotion changes.

acceptance_criteria.when: Scheduled departure time passes
acceptance_criteria.then: No bookings or promotions change the manifest

tasks.confidence_note: Assumed waitlist is not promoted after freeze.

specs.confidence_note: Assumed freeze is by scheduled time, not actual trip start.

epics.title: Live Tracking and Notifications
epics.description: Map tracking, ETA, two-minute push alert and delayed banner.

user_stories.title: Track the shuttle
user_stories.narrative: As a rider, I want to see the shuttle on a map with an ETA, so that I know when to be at the stop

specs.title: Location ingestion and ETA
specs.description: Receive driver location, compute ETA to each boarding stop, and serve it to riders.

tasks.title: Driver location ingestion
tasks.description: Accept location updates from the driver app, stored for 24 hours only. The driver app is built separately; this backend owns the contract: an authenticated POST carrying trip id, latitude, longitude and device timestamp.

acceptance_criteria.when: Driver app posts a location
acceptance_criteria.then: It is stored against the trip

acceptance_criteria.given: The driver app is a separate client
acceptance_criteria.when: A location post is missing the trip id, latitude, longitude or timestamp, is out of range, or is unauthenticated
acceptance_criteria.then: It is rejected with an error and nothing is stored

acceptance_criteria.when: A location record is older than 24 hours
acceptance_criteria.then: It is deleted

tasks.confidence_note: Contract defined by this backend (authenticated POST: trip id, lat, lng, device timestamp); driver app team to conform. Recorded in design.md.

tasks.title: ETA calculation
tasks.description: Estimate arrival at each boarding stop from latest location.

acceptance_criteria.when: A location update arrives
acceptance_criteria.then: ETA for each upcoming stop is recalculated

tasks.confidence_note: BRD gives no ETA method; assumed routing/distance-based estimate.

tasks.title: Tracking map UI
tasks.description: Show map and ETA from 15 minutes before departure, refreshed at least every 10 seconds.

acceptance_criteria.when: Current time is 15 minutes before departure
acceptance_criteria.then: Map with shuttle position and ETA to rider's stop is shown

acceptance_criteria.when: Tracking screen is open
acceptance_criteria.then: Position refreshes at least every 10 seconds

user_stories.title: Arrival and delay alerts
user_stories.narrative: As a rider, I want alerts when the shuttle is near or late, so that I'm at the stop on time

specs.title: Notifications
specs.description: Push delivery, two-minute alert once per rider per trip, and delayed banner.

tasks.title: Push notification service
tasks.description: Send push notifications to riders on Android and iOS via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for both platforms.

acceptance_criteria.when: A notification is sent to a rider
acceptance_criteria.then: It is delivered to their device via FCM (Android and iOS)

tasks.title: Two-minute alert
tasks.description: Notify rider when shuttle is two minutes from their stop, deduplicated per rider per trip.

acceptance_criteria.when: Shuttle ETA to rider's stop drops to two minutes, repeatedly
acceptance_criteria.then: Exactly one push is sent per rider per trip

tasks.title: Delayed banner
tasks.description: Show 'delayed' banner if driver has not started trip five minutes after scheduled departure.

acceptance_criteria.when: Five minutes pass after scheduled departure without trip start
acceptance_criteria.then: Rider sees a delayed banner

epics.title: Boarding and No-shows
epics.description: Driver manifest boarding and no-show restrictions.

user_stories.title: Mark riders boarded
user_stories.narrative: As a driver, I want a manifest per stop where I can mark riders boarded, so that I know who is on board

specs.title: Manifest API
specs.description: Backend endpoints serving the manifest and recording boarding for the driver app.

tasks.title: Manifest and boarding endpoints
tasks.description: List confirmed riders per stop; mark a rider boarded.

acceptance_criteria.when: Driver requests the manifest
acceptance_criteria.then: Confirmed riders are listed grouped by stop

acceptance_criteria.when: Driver taps a rider
acceptance_criteria.then: Rider is marked boarded

specs.confidence_note: Driver app is separate; assumed this app's backend exposes the endpoints.

user_stories.title: No-show handling
user_stories.narrative: As a dispatcher, I want repeat no-shows restricted, so that seats are not wasted

specs.title: No-show tracking and restriction
specs.description: Mark no-shows when shuttle leaves a stop and apply waitlist-only restriction.

tasks.title: Mark no-shows
tasks.description: Mark confirmed unboarded riders No-show when shuttle leaves their stop.

acceptance_criteria.when: Shuttle leaves a stop and a confirmed rider is not boarded
acceptance_criteria.then: Rider is marked No-show

tasks.confidence_note: 'Leaves their stop' assumed detected from driver location or driver action.

tasks.title: Waitlist-only restriction
tasks.description: After three no-shows in 30 days, force new bookings to Waitlist for 7 days.

acceptance_criteria.when: Rider's third no-show within 30 days is recorded
acceptance_criteria.then: Their bookings for the next 7 days are Waitlist only

acceptance_criteria.when: 7 days have passed
acceptance_criteria.then: Rider can be Confirmed again

tasks.confidence_note: Assumed the 7 days start at the third no-show and existing bookings are unaffected.

epics.title: Dispatcher Operations
epics.description: Dispatcher cancels a departure and riders are notified.

user_stories.title: Cancel a shuttle run
user_stories.narrative: As a dispatcher, I want to cancel a departure, so that riders are informed and bookings cleared

specs.title: Departure cancellation
specs.description: Cancel departure, cancel all bookings and notify riders.

tasks.title: Cancel departure
tasks.description: Cancel departure, cancel all confirmed and waitlisted bookings, notify each rider.

acceptance_criteria.when: Dispatcher cancels a departure
acceptance_criteria.then: All confirmed and waitlisted bookings are cancelled and each rider is notified

tasks.title: Dispatcher trips view
tasks.description: Dispatcher-role view within the mobile app to view all trips and trigger cancellation.

acceptance_criteria.given: User is signed in to the mobile app with the dispatcher role
acceptance_criteria.when: Dispatcher opens the trips view
acceptance_criteria.then: All trips are listed and a run can be cancelled; users without the dispatcher role cannot access the view

epics.title: Platform and Resilience
epics.description: Non-functional requirements: platform support and offline behavior.

user_stories.title: Use the app offline
user_stories.narrative: As a rider, I want to see my last known booking state offline, so that I still know my seat status

specs.title: Offline cache and platform support
specs.description: Cache booking state locally with stale marker; support Android 10+ and iOS 15+.

tasks.title: Offline booking state cache
tasks.description: Persist last known booking state and show a stale marker when offline.

acceptance_criteria.when: Device is offline
acceptance_criteria.then: Last known booking state is shown with a stale marker

tasks.title: Platform compatibility
tasks.description: Build and verify on Android 10+ and iOS 15+.

acceptance_criteria.when: App is installed on Android 10 and iOS 15
acceptance_criteria.then: Booking and tracking flows work
